name: Amulet of Health
description: Your Constitution score is 19 while you wear this amulet. It has no effect on you if your Constitution is already 19 or higher without it.

name: Armor, +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: Armor, +2
description: You have a +2 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: Armor, +3
description: You have a +3 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

name: Bag of Holding
description: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions, roughly 2 feet in diameter at the mouth and 4 feet deep. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet, while always weighing 15 pounds. Retrieving an item from the bag requires an action.

name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
description: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 21.

name: Boots of Elvenkind
description: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on moving silently.

name: Bracers of Defense
description: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to AC if you are wearing no armor and using no shield.

name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: While you wear this cloak with its hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks made to see you have disadvantage, and you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

name: Cloak of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

name: Flame Tongue

activatedAbilities.name: Ignite Flame Tongue
activatedAbilities.description: You use a bonus action to speak the command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade (bright light 40 ft, dim light 40 ft). While ablaze, the sword deals an extra 2d6 fire damage to any target it hits. Use a bonus action to speak the command word again (or drop or sheathe the sword) to extinguish the flames.

description: You can use a bonus action to speak this magic sword’s command word, causing flames to erupt from the blade and deal an extra 2d6 fire damage on a hit.

name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
description: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets.

name: Longsword, +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic longsword.

name: Pearl of Power
description: While this pearl is on your person, you can use it to regain one expended spell slot as an action. The slot must be 3rd level or lower. Once used, the pearl can't be used again until the next dawn.

name: Periapt of Wound Closure

activatedAbilities.name: Wound Closure
activatedAbilities.description: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn, and whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, double the number of hit points it restores. (Passive — no action required.)

effects.title: Wound Closure
effects.guidance: You stabilize at 0 HP (death saves reset, stable) at the start of your turn while dying, and you double Hit Die healing while attuned and wearing this pendant.

description: While you wear this pendant, you stabilize whenever you are dying at the start of your turn. In addition, whenever you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, double the number of hit points it restores.

name: Potion of Greater Healing

activatedAbilities.name: Drink Potion of Greater Healing
activatedAbilities.description: You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion.

description: You regain 4d4 + 4 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Superior Healing

activatedAbilities.name: Drink Potion of Superior Healing
activatedAbilities.description: You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion.

description: You regain 8d4 + 8 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Potion of Supreme Healing

activatedAbilities.name: Drink Potion of Supreme Healing
activatedAbilities.description: You regain 10d4 + 20 hit points when you drink this potion.

description: You regain 10d4 + 20 hit points when you drink this potion.

name: Ring of Fire Resistance
description: You have resistance to fire damage while wearing this ring. (Ring of Resistance, attuned to fire.)

name: Ring of Protection
description: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while wearing this ring.

name: Rod of the Pact Keeper, +1
description: While holding this rod, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and to the saving throw DCs of your warlock spells. In addition, you can regain one warlock spell slot as an action while holding the rod. This property can't be used again until you finish a long rest.

name: Spell Scroll (Fireball)

activatedAbilities.name: Cast Fireball (Scroll)
activatedAbilities.description: A spell scroll bearing the words of the fireball spell (Save DC 15). Casting from the scroll is slot-free and consumes the scroll.

description: A spell scroll bears the words of the fireball spell, written in a mystical cipher (Save DC 15).

name: Shield, +1
description: While holding this shield, you have a +1 bonus to AC in addition to the shield’s normal bonus to AC.

name: Shield, +2
description: While holding this shield, you have a +2 bonus to AC in addition to the shield’s normal bonus to AC.

name: Shield, +3
description: While holding this shield, you have a +3 bonus to AC in addition to the shield’s normal bonus to AC.

name: Wand of Magic Missiles

activatedAbilities.name: Magic Missile (1 Charge)
activatedAbilities.description: Expend 1 charge to cast magic missile as a 1st-level spell (3 darts dealing 1d4 + 1 force damage each).

description: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the magic missile spell from it.

name: Weapon, +1
description: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Weapon, +2
description: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

name: Weapon, +3
description: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
